summary: A highly symmetrical, square-footprint structure featuring four tall corner towers and a central stepped pyramidal roof. The walls are primarily brick with stone brick accents, decorated with prominent white horizontal bands and cross motifs.
rebuild_hints: Start with a 23x23 square footprint, placing 5x5 towers at each corner.
Construct the main walls using brick, integrating two horizontal bands of white blocks.
Add a large white cross motif centered on each of the four main exterior walls.
Build the central roof as a stepped pyramid using dark blocks, likely nether brick stairs/slabs.
Cap each of the four towers with a flat, overhanging roof bordered by stone bricks.
Place a single light-emitting block at the very top center of the main roof and each tower.
uncertainties: Exact material of the white decorative blocks (quartz, concrete, or wool).
Exact material of the dark roof blocks (nether brick or dark wood).
Interior layout and contents are completely unknown.
